description: The front of a 20-t hydraulic excavator (boom 5.7 m, arm 2.9 m, bucket 1.5 m) on planar multibond mechanics with the real cylinder linkage (bucket four-bar included), driven by a load-sensing pump and pre-compensated valve sections, digging loam with the fundamental earthmoving equation. design/design.py computes the references: forward kinematics from the cylinder lengths, static cylinder forces, the hydraulic modes, the earthmoving factors.

checks.note: no solver failure, no connection or causality error, no derivative causality, no algebraic loop (every valve sits between two volumes) and no event-limit stop
bucket tip x at the hold t = 6.5 s: scipy forward kinematics of the three set lengths (brentq on each cylinder length, the bucket through the four-bar), design.py
bucket tip y at the hold t = 6.5 s: scipy forward kinematics of the three set lengths (brentq on each cylinder length, the bucket through the four-bar), design.py
